results.title: Methods for Validating Reference Materials
results.content: ### Explore Fusion. ### Explore Consumables. ### Explore Instruments. ### Explore Platinum. ### Explore Applications. # Methods for Validating Reference Materials. Reference materials are used widely across scientific fields to ensure the accuracy and reliability of analytical results. However, how can we be sure that the reference materials used are an accurate standard to measure results against? Validating reference materials is a critical part of analytical chemistry as it will ensure analytical results are accurate and can be measured reliably. In this blog post, we will look at methods for validating reference materials, with a focus on fused calibration beads and synthetic ion ore materials.
